Guided tours of the Château de Voltaire

Tours for curious travellers, groups, history lovers, companies and pupils. Every format can be adjusted — just ask.

Every tour includes Voltaire’s gardens

  • Individual & standard tours
  • Group tours (adults & tourists)
  • Themed group tours
  • Special audiences

Individual & standard tours

For travellers, couples and families who want to discover the château with a guide.

The classic château tour

The estate’s highlights in one hour: the house, the salon, Voltaire’s bedroom and the park with its view of Mont Blanc.

  • Voltaire, “the innkeeper of Europe”
  • The restored rooms and their décor
  • The park and the view of the Alps
Duration
1 h
Group
1–12 people

Ideal for: First-time visitors, travellers passing through

Book this tour

Private tour of the Castle of Voltaire

Just for you and your companions: we take time for your questions and your interests.

  • Time and pace chosen together
  • Child-friendly content if needed
  • Can be offered as a gift
Duration
1 h 15
Group
1–8 people

Ideal for: Families, couples, history lovers

Book this tour

Group tours (adults & tourists)

For associations, tour operators, coach companies and groups of friends. Large groups are split into sub-groups with coordinated timings.

Group discovery tour

The château and its gardens, told through Voltaire’s daily life and his great causes.

  • Welcome for the group and the driver
  • Tour of the château and park
  • Suggested free time afterwards
Duration
1 h 30
Group
10–30 people

Ideal for: Associations, tour operators, clubs, friends

Learn more

Request a quote

Château & Voltaire’s town

A historical tour of Ferney-Voltaire in English, French, German or Russian: from the château to the town centre, see how Voltaire turned a village into a town of watchmakers and tolerance.

  • The church inscribed “Deo erexit Voltaire”
  • Ferney’s watchmaking boom
  • Voltaire’s statue in the heart of town
Duration
2 h
Group
10–30 people

Ideal for: Groups wanting a full half-day

Learn more

Request a quote

Themed group tours

A common thread to explore one side of Voltaire’s life and work in depth.

Voltaire and the Age of Enlightenment

Candide, the Treatise on Tolerance, the Calas affair: how one man fought the battles of his century from Ferney.

  • Letters with Catherine the Great and Frederick II
  • The defence of Calas and Sirven
  • “Écrasez l’infâme”: freedom of thought
Duration
1 h 30
Group
8–30 people

Ideal for: History lovers, students, cultural societies

Learn more

Request a quote

Life at the château

Dinners, theatre, illustrious guests, servants and a niece: step into the everyday life of the “Patriarch of Ferney”.

  • Madame Denis, mistress of the house
  • Theatre and celebrations
  • Famous visitors to the estate
Duration
1 h 30
Group
8–30 people

Ideal for: Groups who love daily life and anecdotes

Learn more

Request a quote

Gardens & charmilles

A walk through the park, its hornbeam arbours (charmilles) and its views of the Alps, following Voltaire the gardener and agronomist.

  • The charmille, a leafy covered walk
  • “We must cultivate our garden”
  • Voltaire as farmer and builder
Duration
1 h 15
Group
8–30 people

Ideal for: Garden lovers, spring to autumn

Learn more
